samplingPolicy.standalonePlaneA: retain every disconnected 1x1 Plane-A production component as a visual-only frontend family

samplingPolicy.terrainFootprint: native MT/ML semantic footprint converted to matching terrain families
samplingPolicy.families: similar production samples are hidden behind one smart motif family; progressive stages are ordered from smallest to largest production fragment
